reason: A structurally valid request for a season that never existed. MEASURED 2026-08-15: the endpoint answers HTTP 200 with a COMPLETE envelope - all 29 headers present, rowSet empty. It is not a malformed body, which is why the offline error-path tests assert an empty rowSet rather than a missing one. Lives outside the partitioned tree because a season=2099-00 partition inside it would be globbed by the bronze source and force the row-count fidelity test to special-case it. A genuine 5xx or block-page body remains unmeasured - the endpoint returns 200 for nonsense seasons and forcing a real error would mean abusing a host this project is deliberately polite to.
why_not_partitioned: '_error_cases' is not a landing partition and is never globbed by a dbt source: a body without resultSets[0].headers breaks schema unification across the bronze glob.
